market.note: NEPSE fell 15.43 points after four consecutive advancing sessions. Turnover remained above Rs 4.19bn, so the decline came with active participation.

setups.name: Reliance Spinning Mills
setups.evidence: High turnover leader; LTP 2,993; MA5 and MA20 bullish; pivot 2,993 with R1 3,045 and R2 3,097.
setups.counterpoint: Price remains below the 120/180-day averages, and today's close is near resistance. Breakout confirmation matters.

setups.name: NRN Infrastructure & Development
setups.evidence: High turnover; LTP 1,405; MA5 and MA20 bullish; price holding above S1 1,391.
setups.counterpoint: Still below MA180 and therefore not a clean higher-timeframe trend reversal.

setups.name: Shivam Cements
setups.evidence: High turnover; LTP 662.60; MA5, MA20 and MA180 remain bullish; price is close to pivot 667.
setups.counterpoint: Manufacturing sector was down 0.28% and price is still below MA120; failure around 667–674 weakens the setup.

base.label: Range / selective recovery
base.detail: NEPSE holds roughly 2,543–2,500 while buyers selectively defend liquid leaders.

bull.label: Reclaim 2,560+

bear.label: Breakdown below 2,543
bear.detail: A decisive break of today's low with weak breadth could open a deeper pullback.
